description: Accounts in Hebrew script. Language unidentified. Late. The scribal hand is akin, but not identical to the commercial accounts of ENA NS 1066.1-10 (PGPID 9938), which contain a linguistic mixture of Hebrew, Italian, and Yiddish. See also: https://dpul.princeton.edu/coins_geniza/feature/7-florin-15th-16th-centuries-ce. Requires further examination.
